detail.subtitle: We work with companies and professionals who need a solid digital presence. Every site is built around business goals, audience, and the services or products you want to highlight.

items.label: 01 — Corporate sites
items.title: Web design
items.body: We build corporate sites that present your company, services and differentiators clearly. Ideal for businesses that need quotes, contact requests or bookings.
items.note: **Includes:** responsive design, strategic sections, contact forms, WhatsApp integration, speed optimization and SEO foundations.

items.label: 02 — E-commerce
items.title: Online stores
items.body: We develop online stores that are easy to manage and designed to make buying simple. Categories, products, payments and shipping flow around your business needs.
items.note: **Ideal for:** brands, retailers, founders and companies selling online.

items.label: 03 — Campaigns
items.title: Landing pages
items.body: We design landing pages for campaigns, specific services, product launches and lead capture.
items.note: **Goal:** focus the visitor on one clear action — quote, book, buy or contact you.

items.label: 04 — Search
items.title: SEO for websites
items.body: We optimize structure, content and technical performance so Google understands your site and shows it to people looking for your services.
items.note: **We work on:** search intent, content architecture, titles, meta descriptions, internal links, speed and structured data.

items.label: 05 — AI search
items.title: GEO for ChatGPT, Gemini and Google
items.body: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) prepares your site so AI search engines understand your business and can recommend it when people ask questions.
items.note: **We work on:** content that answers real questions, clear structure, structured data, consistent business info and trust signals.

items.label: 06 — Advertising
items.title: Google Ads
items.body: We create and manage Google campaigns to reach people already searching for your products or services, with conversion tracking so you know what works.
items.note: **Includes:** keyword research, campaign setup, ads, conversion tracking and ongoing optimization.
